features.name: Atomic Wild
features.description: A random wild with a 10x–100x multiplier.

features.name: Stukas
features.description: Split symbols diagonally to double them.

review:
A war game on a diamond-shaped 3-4-5-4-3 grid, full of random modifiers. The Atomic Wild drops a 10x to 100x multiplier wild, Bombers turn whole reels wild, Stukas split symbols diagonally, and Panzers turn low symbols on their row wild.

There are more, like the Howitzer, and several can stack on one spin. The theme won't be for everyone, but the variety of modifiers is huge. Extreme volatility, 55,555x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
